_comment: Per-track distill goals for run_overnight_queue.sh; single-line strings; modeled on builtin goetia goal. 2026-10-27.
arbatel: You are working from a chunk of the ARBATEL of 1559 (the Heptameron of the Magical Texts). Extract: the nineteen Olympic spirits (name including Hebrew-letter forms, governing planet/zodiac, offices/governments, their witnesses), the hours and days each is called, the prayers and invocations used (quote the names they call), the Armatron circle and the three-witness doctrine, and the nine aphorisms' structure. Preserve exact name spellings. If an attribute is unclear, return NEEDS_VERIFICATION for it.
ars_almadel: You are working from a chunk of THE ALMADEL (Book IV of the Lemegeton; 9-page excerpt edition). Extract: the twelve governors of the wax table (names, offices, hours of operation), the orders/ministers subject to them, the form of call and suffumigations, candles and table-confection procedure. Flag NEEDS_VERIFICATION where the excerpt truncates a list.
grimoire_turiel: You are working from a chunk of the GRIMOIRE OF TURIEL. Extract named spirits with their hierarchy class (created-faithful, fallen, neutral, etc.), offices attributed (fire/air/waters/earth, treasures, etc.), the oraison formulas (quote names invoked), and any numbered legions. Preserve exact spellings and hierarchy attributions; unclear attributes get NEEDS_VERIFICATION.
grand_grimoire: You are working from a chunk of THE GRAND GRIMOIRE / THE RED DRAGON. Extract: Lucifuge Rofocale (title, office, description), the hierarchy he heads, spirits named in the Preliminary/Oath/Mass sections (e.g. bearers of the black ring, the lion, the eagle, the bull), the pact formulas verbatim, the cross-roads procedure steps, and the ring's requirements. Quote formulas exactly.
black_pullet: You are working from a chunk of THE BLACK PULLET (La Poule Noire). Extract: the ring's engraving and consecration, the cabal of spirits by name (the twenty-one great princes and the forty-three spirits of the cabal) with any offices/seals attributed, the suffumigations and prayers (quote invoked names), and conjuration formula steps. Preserve exact spellings.
key_of_solomon: You are working from a chunk of THE GREATER KEY OF SOLOMON (Mathers translation; multiple part-files concatenated). Extract: the four kings of the cardinal directions (name, direction, office, and subject spirits listed under them), the patrons/genii of the canonical hours, the consecration of instruments (circle, hexagram, pentagram, sword, candle, lance, incense), each pentacle and its intended use, and where present the spirit classes and grades of Ars Theurgia Goetia / Paulina / Necromantia / Fortunita. Preserve exact spellings and direction/grade assignments.
pgm_betz: You are working from a chunk of the GREEK MAGICAL PAPYRI IN TRANSLATION (Betz ed.). Extract per spell: the spell title and PGM siglum (e.g. PGM XII.281-92), voces magicae (vowel bars — copy exactly), divine/daimonic and syncretic names invoked, ritual implements and materials, planetary-hour timing, and any historical or mythological personages. Preserve transliteration spellings exactly; mark uncertain restorations NEEDS_VERIFICATION.
picatrix_english: You are working from a chunk of the PICATRIX (Ghayat al-Hakim) in Greer & Warnock's English translation. Extract: the named spirits/demons of the spheres with their governance and offices, planetary deities with their names/epithets, days and hours, talismans with materials and figures, invocations and prayers (quote the names they call), suffumigation/incense recipes, and note the book/chapter structure. Preserve exact spellings. This is a modern annotated translation — do not treat editor commentary as source entities.
picatrix_latin: You are working from a chunk of the PICATRIX in Pingree's critical Latin edition. Extract LATIN spirit/demon names (including nomina barbarorum), planetary names and epithets, and the operations/capitula titles. Quote exact Latin spellings and chapter references. This track is a witness for latin forms against the English track — do NOT normalize names to English or modern spellings.
infernal_dictionary: You are working from a chunk of Colin de Plancy's DICTIONNAIRE INFERNAL (1863). It is an encyclopedia: for EVERY substantive entry extract the demon/deity/practitioner name, class, rank or office where Plancy gives one, attributes and the legend/description gist, and cross-references to other entries or to named grimoires. Dictionary entries are short — extract every meaningful entity. Do not invent ranks or attributes the entry lacks; use NEEDS_VERIFICATION for illustrative-only entries.
magic_middle_ages: You are working from a chunk of Richard Kieckhefer, MAGIC IN THE MIDDLE AGES (scholarly study). This is a CONTEXT track: extract named demons/spirits discussed, named practitioners and trial cases with dates, and cited grimoires/manuscripts (CLA sigla where given). Do NOT create entities from the author's own generalities or interpretations.
pgm_wiki: You are working from a chunk of an anonymous digest of selected GREEK MAGICAL PAPYRI texts keyed by PGM sigla. This is a SECONDARY witness (non-authoritative digest): extract spell sigla, voces magicae, and invoked names exactly as written, but mark the track provenance as digest, not a critical edition.
godwin_necromancers: You are working from a chunk of William Godwin, THE LIVES OF THE NECROMANCERS (1834), an OCR'd secondary compendium. Extract named practitioners (with era/where said), named spirits/demons appearing in the cited stories, and cited works. Flag OCR-damaged name forms NEEDS_VERIFICATION.
budge_egyptian_book_dead: You are working from a chunk of Budge's translation of THE EGYPTIAN BOOK OF THE DEAD. Extract deity names, named spirits of the places/regions (tuat), and spell numbers/titles where given. Context track — prioritize precision over breadth.
budge_legends_gods: You are working from a chunk of Budge's LEGENDS OF THE GODS. Extract deity names with their attributes and the legends summarized. Context track; precision over breadth.
budge_egyptian_magic: You are working from a chunk of Budge's EGYPTIAN MAGIC. Extract named powers invoked in the rituals described, amulets/objects with names, and ritual apparatus. Context track; precision over breadth.
handbook_egyptian_religion: You are working from a chunk of a scholarly HANDBOOK OF EGYPTIAN RELIGION. Extract deity names with attributes/roles only where explicitly stated; no entities from general scholarly commentary.
pyramid_texts: You are working from a chunk of PYRAMID TEXTS — CRITICAL ANALYSIS (provenance of this edition unclear). Extract deity and spirit names with utterance/spell numbers where given, and flag the edition provenance NEEDS_VERIFICATION in every entity provenance note.
babylonian_omens: You are working from a chunk of BABYLONIAN BIRTH OMENS. Extract deity names invoked in omen formulas and the menological structure (month names, omens by birth date). Context track.
aryan_sun_myths: You are working from a chunk of Godfrey Higgins, ARYAN SUN MYTHS (1833) — fringe comparative mythology. Extract deity/myth names only as claimed identifications, marked as Higgins' 19th-c. interpretations; never treat identifications as attested fact.
ritos_muertos: You are working from a chunk of RITOS Y MITOS DE LA MUERTE EN MÉXICO (Spanish, 2000). Extract named death-related figures/spirits of folklore and described rituals. Context track for the worship_dead family; extract Spanish names as written.
eleogap: MODERN RECONSTRUCTION witness (Stratton-Kent's Eleogap, 2019). Extract the spirit names used and note this is a 21st-century exorcism construction — a retrofit-lineage entity layer, NOT a medieval source.
frimost_klepot: MODERN RECONSTRUCTION witness (Stratton-Kent's Frimost & Klepot, 2019). Extract spirit names and lineage claims; retrofit layer, not a historical source.
goetic_divination: MODERN RECONSTRUCTION witness (Stratton-Kent's Goetic Divination, 2018). Extract spirit names and methods; retrofit layer, not a historical source.
headless_one: MODERN RECONSTRUCTION witness (Stratton-Kent's Headless One, 2018 — Obazania tradition). Extract spirit names and tradition claims; retrofit layer.
strattonkent_trve_grimoire: MODERN RECONSTRUCTION witness (Stratton-Kent, The Trve Grimoire, 2023). Extract spirit names and source-lineage claims; retrofit layer.
liber_falxifer_i: MODERN RECONSTRUCTION witness (Liber Falxifer I, 2nd ed.). Extract spirit names and the Necromanticon's attributed lineage; retrofit layer.
liber_falxifer_ii: MODERN RECONSTRUCTION witness (Liber Falxifer II). Extract spirit names and attributed lineage; retrofit layer.
goetic_pharmakos: MODERN witness (Goetic Pharmakos, 21st c.). Extract spirit names/formulas; retrofit layer.
crowley_illustrated_goetia: RETROFIT-WITNESS layer: extract the Goetia names/seals attributed to Crowleys system and note construction order vs the 1904 Mathers goetia track; retrofit witness, not primary.
lunar_formula_iao: MODERN witness (Lunar Formula of I-A-O). Extract names/formulas; retrofit layer.
henson_lemegeton: MODERN witness (Henson Lemegeton edition). Extract spirit roster and differences vs the Mathers Lemegeton; retrofit witness.
davies_grimoires: Scholarly history (Owen Davies, Grimoires: A History of Magic Books, 2009) — CONTEXT track only: extract named grimoires, printers, trial cases with dates. No entities from general commentary.
aradia: Extract the named figures (Diana, Aradia/Lucifer, etc.) and ritual formulas from Lelands Aradia, as attested in this edition; preserve exact spellings.
geosophia_v1: Marginal theosophical text — extract only clearly named entities; precision over breadth.
geosophia_v2: Marginal theosophical text — extract only clearly named entities; precision over breadth.
conway_demonology_v1: Modern popular compendium (Conway) — extract spirit names only as attributed claims; low-authority context track; never treat as attestation.
